items.title: Father Al Lewis Interview, 1972-02-21
items.q: And Buster Millier was a guy that looked like Gilbert Young, but he played like Sun Johnson.

ctx.x: And also Henry Rust, we talked to Henry Rust a couple of weeks ago and he talked about when you played with him in Chinatown. Yeah, yeah, he too. Yeah, yeah. So who was in that band? It was just a four piece player?

Chinatown? Where? Chinatown? Chinatown? Raymond Carr was playing drums. See, Rust was playing drums first, then Rust switched to trumpet. You hired him on trumpet? No, he was, well, Gordette left me and went with Joe Robichaud, you understand, Robichaud's band. And Pigeon used to arrange music for me and Gordette was out there Chinatown. Used to arrange the music, you see. I used to get a lot of orchestration, big orchestration, well I'd swap for Walter, you know, for something small, or write something small for…
Who is this guy, Joe Benoit? Benoit, sir Benoit. Joe Benoit? Joe Benoit was a drum player.
